sos.stay_calm: Stay calm. Don't move if injured.

triage.fallback_error: Connecting you to emergency lines. Please call 108 or 112 immediately.

step1.title: Don't move the victim
step1.sub: Spinal injuries are common in crashes. Moving the person before help arrives can worsen paralysis.

step2.title: Call 112 now
step2.sub: Free. Works on any network, even without a SIM. Ask for ambulance and police.

step3.title: Check breathing
step3.sub: Look, listen, feel. Tilt the head back gently to open the airway. If no breathing, start CPR.

step4.title: Stop the bleeding
step4.sub: Press a clean cloth or dupatta firmly on the wound. Don't remove it — apply more on top.

step5.title: Recovery position
step5.sub: If the person is breathing but unconscious, gently roll them onto their side to prevent choking.

step6.title: Guide the ambulance
step6.sub: Share your live WhatsApp location with the 108 driver. Stand at the road to wave them down.
